entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I ordered a jersey and it's just not right. I'm so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed with your purchase. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. I finally got a chance to try it on for a ride, and it's just way too tight. I really thought I ordered the right one, but I can barely breathe in it.
I see. Sizing can be tricky, and I understand the frustration. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and this has never happened. I was just so looking forward to it, you know?

Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the ClubFit Jersey, delivered on December 23rd. Since you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, we can absolutely take care of this for you.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. It's been a tough month and I really needed this money back if I couldn't get a new one.
Of course, I completely understand. We can definitely process an exchange for the correct size if you'd like. Would that work for you?
Yes, an exchange would be perfect. I'd be so grateful. Thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. I've just initiated the exchange process and emailed you a pre-paid return label. Just send the original jersey back to us, and we'll get the new size shipped out right away.
That's wonderful. You've really helped me out today.
I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Have a great day and enjoy your new gear once it arrives! Thanks for calling VeloFit.
